relationships.subject: endothelial TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: These data demonstrate that endothelial, but not hematopoietic, TLR4 expression is necessary to initiate vaso-occlusive physiology in SS mice.

key_findings: Global Tlr4 knockout in sickle (SS) mice did not change baseline hemolysis but markedly reduced microvascular stasis after hemin, LPS or hypoxia/reoxygenation.
Bone marrow chimeras showed endothelial, not hematopoietic, TLR4 is required for vaso-occlusion, via NF-κB p65 phosphorylation and adhesion molecule expression.
